description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the Thunder framework, including classes and structures for plugin lifecycle, notifications, communication, security, and WebSocket interactions. It declares the IPlugin interface and related nested interfaces for plugin notifications, lifecycle management, extended plugin features, composite plugins, web request handling, WebSocket communication, text socket communication, channel data transfer, security, and authentication.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin interface providing lifecycle methods (Initialize, Deinitialize, Information) and nested interfaces for notifications and lifetime management.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extension of IPlugin adding communication capabilities via Attach and Detach methods for WebSocket channels.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins supporting callback registration and management.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for handling web requests and responses within plugins.

classes.name: IWebSocket
classes.description: Interface for WebSocket communication, handling inbound messages and responses.

classes.name: ITextSocket
classes.description: Interface for text-based socket communication, handling inbound messages and responses.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data transfer over communication channels, supporting inbound and outbound data.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security checks on WebSocket upgrades, requests, and JSONRPC messages, and for retrieving security tokens.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for creating security tokens and obtaining security officer interfaces based on tokens.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Called when a plugin is loaded to perform initial setup with provided shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Called when a plugin is unloaded to perform cleanup.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin as a JSON string.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Associates a WebSocket channel with the plugin for communication.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Removes the association of a WebSocket channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Registers a callback interface for the composite plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests or WebSocket messages.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a web request and returns a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages as JSON elements.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages with an identifier.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming raw data on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Sends raw data over a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket upgrade or request is permitted.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a security token from provided data.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Returns a security interface associated with a token.
